cases.summary: Cannot access pgmq_public functions on local instance.
cases.description: # Bug report - [x] I confirm this is a bug with Supabase, not with my own application. - [x] I confirm I have searched the [Docs](https://docs.supabase.com), GitHub [Discussions](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/discussions), and [Discord](https://discord.supabase.com). ## Describe the bug Cannot enable PostgREST for queues on local instance. ## To Reproduce Steps to reproduce the behavior, please provide code snippets or a repository: 1. Log in to local instance of studio 1. Go to Integrations -> Queues -> Settings 2. Click on radio button "Expose Queues via PostgREST" 3. Click "Save Changes" 4. See error in the upper right It appears that the `pgmq_public` schema is created even when seeing this error. ## Expected behavior The `pgmq_public` schema is created and I can access its functions using the Supabase JS client. (Note: this is what happens on the cloud-hosted instance. This error is only reproducible with a local instance.) ## Actual behavior The `pgmq_public` schema is created and the functions are listed in the dashboard. However, even after creating a queue and updating its permissions to allow access, attempting to access the schema using the JavaScript client results in this error: "The schema must be one of the following: public, graphql_public" The exact same edge function works fine on the cloud-base instance. **System information** - Version of OS: Windows 11 - Version of CLI: v2.30.4 - Version of Docker: v4.40.0 ```shell $ npx supabase services SERVICE IMAGE | LOCAL | LINKED ------------------------|------------------------|-------- supabase/postgres | 17.4.1.048 | - supabase/gotrue | v2.176.1 | - postgrest/postgrest | v12.2.12 | - supabase/realtime | v2.38.0 | - supabase/storage-api | v1.24.7 | - supabase/edge-runtime | v1.67.4 | - supabase/studio | 2025.06.30-sha-6f5982d | - supabase/postgres-meta | v0.89.3 | - supabase/logflare | 1.14.2 | - supabase/supavisor | 2.5.6 | - ```

evidence.eventual_fix_title: fix(QueuesSettings): skip PostgREST config update for self-hosted projects
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement: fix(QueuesSettings): skip PostgREST config update for self-hosted projects ## I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) file. YES ## What kind of change does this PR introduce? Bug fix #37020 ## What is the current behavior? PATCH request is made after `pgmq_public` schema is created/deleted, trying to update postgREST config to add/remove `pgmq_public` schema from list of exposed schemas which is supposed to be made only on hosted platform. This is a different issue than the one resolved in #40023 as that's about function signature mismatch. ## What is the new behavior? Not make a PATCH request to update postgREST config on self-hosted instances as when self-hosting exposed schemas have to be configured via env var PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS. when using supabase cli, it has to be configured in config.toml https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8c9180cc-c904-49c2-b3e2-a84dd682b316 **UPDATE**: Added a link to expose pgmq_public schema guide which only renders when `!IS_PLATFORM`
